newsitem.title: UK: NWE GASOLINE STEADY TO SLIGHTLY FIRMER, BUT SLOW.
newsitem.headline: NWE GASOLINE STEADY TO SLIGHTLY FIRMER, BUT SLOW.

text.p: NWE gasoline was steady to slightly firmer on Tuesday but there was no discernable pickup in business.
Dealers said Rotterdam refinery eurograde barges were asking for $218 fob with bids a good $2 below.
Swaps were about $1 firmer with Aguust talked around $209-210 with September at $203-204.
Dealers said Tuesday's steadiness appeared to be a response to heavy markdowns in recent days but most added that the market could lose further ground if NYMEX comes off later in the day.
